verdict.rationale: The firm says it serves foreign nationals "and their employers" and works with company contacts and HR teams. It also offers the employer-sponsored categories a growing team would need (H-1B, L-1, TN, E-3, O-1), which suggests one provider could handle several hires. However, nothing states a multi-case management offering or a startup/scale-up program; its entrepreneur content covers only individual founder cases. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-case or volume employer program, a stated startup/scale-up offering, case-tracking or portfolio management for multiple employees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases
